ceoMessage.label: CEO Message
ceoMessage.title: Message from the CEO
ceoMessage.quote: We will repay customer trust with better technology and quality than yesterday.
ceoMessage.message:
Hello. I am Sungkwang Lee, CEO of WINAJES.

Since our founding in 2014, WINAJES has built engineering and construction capability across industrial sites in India. Guided by technology and quality, we do our utmost so that our customers' production facilities can operate with stability.

From design through completion, we manage safety, quality, and schedule systematically, with Korean management and local Indian specialists working as one team. Going forward, we will remain a partner that repays customer trust with better technology and quality than yesterday.
ceoMessage.name: Sungkwang Lee
